selection: Manual image/source/photographer curation before any descriptor results; not sampled to represent tourist-photo population. Metadata and visual review informed labels. Calibration and heldout images are different sources and photographer groups. Existing development errors motivated the study; model pretraining overlap is unknown.
inference_order: Calibration inference -> fit score/gap rule -> write and hash policy.json -> heldout inference -> report; no tuning based on heldout results.
